title: Critical step size of stochastic gradient descent for a linear neuron: an exact solution and the role of the input spectrum
abstract: arXiv:2611.30880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online stochastic gradient descent for a single linear neuron in a teacher-student setting with Gaussian inputs of arbitrary covariance. The mean-square errors of the $N$ weights obey a closed linear recursion of dimension $N$, which we solve exactly. We prove that the dynamics converges if and only if the step size is below a critical value $\lambda_c$, given by an explicit scalar equation that involves all the eigenvalues of the input covariance, and we obtain the stationary error of each weight, which diverges at $\lambda_c$. This condition coincides with the classical mean-square stability condition of the least-mean-squares filter; our derivation is elementary and self-contained. We then show that $\lambda_c$ is controlled by the effective rank $\Omega_1$ of the input covariance rather than by the number of parameters, $1/(\Omega_1+2) \leq \lambda_c < 1/\Omega_1$ in rescaled units: the critical step size is inversely propor

translated_title: 线性神经元随机梯度下降的临界步长：精确解与输入谱的作用
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在教师-学生设置下、输入为具有任意协方差的高斯分布时，单个线性神经元的在线随机梯度下降。N 个权重的均方误差服从一个 N 维的封闭线性递推关系，我们对其进行了精确求解。我们证明，当且仅当步长低于临界值 λ_c 时，动力学才会收敛；该临界值由一个显式的标量方程给出，该方程涉及输入协方差的所有特征值；我们还得到了每个权重的平稳误差，该误差在 λ_c 处发散。这一条件与最小均方（LMS）滤波器的经典均方稳定性条件相吻合；我们的推导是初等且自成体系的。随后我们证明，λ_c 由输入协方差的有效秩 Ω_1 控制，而非由参数数量控制：在重新标度的单位下，1/(Ω_1+2) ≤ λ_c < 1/Ω_1，即临界步长与有效秩成反比……
tldr: 该论文对线性神经元的在线随机梯度下降给出了精确解，证明收敛当且仅当步长低于临界值 λ_c，且该临界值由输入协方差的有效秩而非参数数量决定。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an exact solution for online SGD of a linear neuron, proving that convergence holds if and only if the step size is below a critical value λ_c governed by the effective rank of the input covariance rather than the number of parameters.
